categories.title: Custom categories
categories.description: Define the feedback categories for this project. When none are configured, the defaults are used (Bug, Feature request, Performance, UI, Other).
categories.listDescription: Listed in creation order and used on the submit page, public board and list filters.
categories.emptyDescription: The default categories are currently in use. Adding a custom category replaces them.
categories.deleteModalBody: This cannot be undone. The category will no longer appear on the submit page, board or filters; existing feedback keeps its category value.

form.title: New category
form.description: Categories also appear on the submit page, the public board and admin filters.
form.nameHint: You can also use an English identifier such as billing or mobile so API submissions can reuse it.

errors.duplicateName: A category with this name already exists

statuses.title: Status settings
statuses.description: Customize the feedback status flow for this project. When none are configured, the defaults are used (Open, In progress, Resolved, Closed).
statuses.listDescription: Shown on the public board and list filters in ascending position order; a closed status marks the end of the flow.
statuses.emptyDescription: Add custom statuses to replace the system defaults.
statuses.defaultsBanner: The system default statuses are in use. Adding any custom status replaces this list with your configuration and the defaults stop applying.
statuses.deleteModalBody: This cannot be undone. If any feedback still uses this status the server will block the deletion; switch those feedback items first.

form.title: Add status
form.description: Custom statuses replace the system defaults and are used in list filters and on the public board.
form.nameHint: Prefer an English identifier (e.g. reviewing, waiting); it becomes the status value in the API.
form.closedHint: Marks the end of the flow; feedback in this status is treated as closed.

errors.duplicateName: A status with this name already exists

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Automatically POST feedback events to Lark, Slack or another system and keep a record of every delivery.
webhooks.listDescription: A POST request is sent when events fire; expand the logs to inspect each delivery's status code and time.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add an endpoint to sync feedback creation, status changes and other events to your collaboration tools.
webhooks.deleteModalBody: Delivery to this URL will stop and its delivery logs will be removed with it. This cannot be undone.

form.description: Events are delivered to this URL as signed JSON POST requests.
form.urlHint: Only public http/https URLs are accepted; internal addresses and localhost are rejected.
form.urlErrorInvalid: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://
form.eventsError: Select at least one trigger event
form.secretHint: Used to sign X-Webhook-Signature so the receiver can verify the request.

logs.title: Delivery logs
logs.emptyDescription: Send a test or trigger an event; the response status and errors will appear here.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.description: Manage the email addresses subscribed to this project's notifications and their preferences. Records are created automatically when a user votes or submits feedback.
notifications.listDescription: Status updates: email when a feedback status changes. Weekly digest: a weekly summary of this project's feedback activity.
notifications.emptyDescription: When a user votes or submits feedback, their notification preferences are created automatically and can be managed here.
notifications.deleteModalBody: This email will no longer receive notifications for this project. If the user votes or submits feedback again, the preference will be recreated.
